### Borea v0.6.0

Borea is the community content manager for Kitten Space Agency. It finds mods, vehicles and saves, installs them with everything they need into separate instances of the game, and starts the game through StarMap.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Updating from v0.5.x

Click "Update now" on the Home banner, or run `borea update-self`.
Your instances, mods and settings stay as they are.

#### What's new

- **Vehicles and saves.** You now find them in Discover and install them just like mods, with all the mods they need. Before you install a vehicle, you can look at it in 3D, drawn from the parts of your own KSA install.
- **Share your own creations.** Pick a vehicle or a save from any of your instances, describe it, add a few pictures, and publish it on ksamods.gg. Borea finds the mods it needs and draws a cover for you, and a few minutes later every Borea player can find it in Discover.
- **Keep a game build.** An instance can stay on the KSA build it was made for, so a game update no longer breaks your modded setup.
- **Choose the mod loader version per instance.** Each instance can use its own StarMap version, and a missing one installs with one click.

#### Smaller improvements

- "Update all" shows what it will change before it starts.
- Vehicles in Discover have small pictures, and `borea://` links open a listing straight in Borea.
- A mod page shows which mods and vehicles need it, and which mods conflict with it.
- The License filter groups licenses by what they allow, and you can still narrow it down to an exact license.
- When a mod offers a smaller download for your operating system, Borea takes that one.
- A listing whose forums thread is gone shows a warning and is no longer offered for new installs. Anything you already installed keeps working.
- Simplified Chinese is complete, thanks to @kuxiaowo.
- The .NET runtime inside Borea is now 10.0.14, with the latest security fixes.

#### Fixes

- Scrolling with the mouse wheel over an open drop-down could freeze Borea.
- "Update all" stopped after a few mods.
- On Linux, a game path that differed only in upper and lower case was overwritten.

#### Good to know

- A kept build is a full copy of KSA, about 2.8 GB on Windows. You find your kept builds in Settings > Game, and you can remove the ones that no instance uses.
- When a KSA build changes the format of its part files, the 3D preview pauses until a Borea update supports the new format. Everything else keeps working.
- Going back to v0.5.2? It does not know kept builds or the vehicles and saves that Borea installed. Those instances start on the current build again, and the vehicles and saves stay in place but are no longer managed.

#### For mod authors and stewards

- A release can carry smaller archives for each operating system next to the archive for every platform. The [contributing guide](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains how to name them.
- The listing editor reads releases with a tag prefix the same way the index does.
- Stewards have a new Statistics tab.

#### Thank you

Sharing vehicles and saves was built together with @SafeShows, who runs ksamods.gg. Thank you for the great collaboration!
